about: Measured by tests/oracle/gdi-capture (npm run oracle:gdi) with GetTextFace and GetTextExtentPoint32 on fonts made as the VCL makes them. fonts[name][style][size] = [colWidth = TextWidth("W"), rowHeight = TextHeight("Xp"), index into faces]. raster: how every raster cell is made from the atlases (see tests/oracle/gdi-capture/README.md).

rules.plain: P(x, y) = native(floor(x / kx), floor(y / ky)); advance = kx * native advance
rules.bold: P(x, y) | P(x - 1, y); advance + 1 where the native advance is not 0
rules.underline: P(x, y) | (y in lineRows and x < advance); for the bytes in lineExceptions the line is that many pixels long
rules.strikeOut: as underline, with the strike-out rows

textPath.about: Windows takes a text through its Unicode text path (README.md, "Windows' text path"). zeroWidthBar[name][style][size]: the height of the bar, 3 pixels wide from x - 1, that a text of zero-width bytes only is drawn as at that requested size when it has an odd number of bytes or two $1F in a row (otherwise, and at every size not listed, the first byte's cell). fallbackEuro[name][style][size]: the width of $80 in a text on that path, drawn from a fallback font (null where the face is not a raster face).
